Container.Name: alta-control
Container.Overview: Alta Labs Control (self-hosted controller). Alta Labs Docker hub does not use tags like "latest" or "main". Anytime there is an update from Alta, you will need to edit your repository to point to the latest Control image. NOTE: This container requires its' own macvlan network so it can auto discover your Alta Labs products.
Container.Requires: 1. You will need a free license from https://manage.alta.inc/control 2. Make sure the network type you attach the container to is a MACVLAN type. 3. Full instructions for Docker can be found at https://help.alta.inc/hc/en-us/articles/25411696788507-Setting-Up-Alta-Control-With-Docker

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Map external host port to the default container port. This should not be used if the container is set correctly to use a dedicated macvlan network.

Config.Name: Cgroup
Config.Description: Host cgroup scope passed into the container
